# N OF CASES

Keep only the first n cases from the next data pass on.

## Syntax

```text
N OF CASES n.
```

The limit applies after SELECT IF and SAMPLE, wherever they stand in the pass.

## Example

```text
N OF CASES 100.
```

`statscraft help N OF CASES` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
